string-array.name: release_notes
string-array.item: Search finds app shortcuts: the actions an app offers when you long-press its icon, such as a new tab in Chrome, and on Android 11 and later your recent conversations. They\'re listed with the apps, under the Apps tab.
Shortcuts go by their full name where the app gives one, so Clock\'s \"Start\" is found as \"Start stopwatch\".
The line under the search field shows a single total: how many items are indexed, or how many results were found once you type.
Tapping an APK in search opens its folder in the Files app and tells you what to tap there to install it. Before, nothing happened.
